name: geoaeo

tools.name: audit
tools.description: Audit a live URL or local site directory for GEO and AEO gaps. Reads the target and returns a report; it changes no files. Fetches over the network when the target is a URL.

target.description: A local directory or an absolute http(s) URL. When GEOAEO_ALLOWED_ROOTS is set, a local directory must resolve inside one root. An http(s) URL stays allowed.

tools.name: gen
tools.description: Generate one GEO or AEO artifact from the local site config. Returns the artifact as text; it does not write a file.

artifact.description: Which GEO or AEO artifact to generate. It is returned as text; no file is written.

type.description: Applies only when artifact is jsonld.

directory.description: Absolute path to the site root. Defaults to the MCP server's working directory, which is usually not the project you mean — pass it explicitly. When GEOAEO_ALLOWED_ROOTS is set, the path must resolve inside one root.

tools.name: humanize
tools.description: Find AI-writing tells in prose files. Reports findings without changing files by default; with write true it rewrites matching files in place, so ask the user first.

glob.description: Glob pattern matching the prose files to scan. Reads the matches; changes nothing unless write is true.

write.description: Default false. true rewrites matching files in place. Set true only after the user asked to change files.

directory.description: Absolute path to the site root. Defaults to the MCP server's working directory, which is usually not the project you mean — pass it explicitly. When GEOAEO_ALLOWED_ROOTS is set, the path must resolve inside one root.

tools.name: submit
tools.description: Post URLs to IndexNow so Bing, Yandex, Naver, Seznam, and Yep recrawl them. Needs the key the site already serves at https://<host>/<key>.txt. This calls a third party; ask the user first.

urls.description: Absolute http(s) URLs to announce. Every one must sit on the host.

key.description: IndexNow key the site serves at https://<host>/<key>.txt. 8 to 128 hex characters.

host.description: Host that owns the URLs, without a scheme. Defaults to the first URL's host.

keyLocation.description: Absolute URL of the key file. Defaults to https://<host>/<key>.txt.

instructions: Call only audit, gen, humanize, or submit. Audit a local directory or an http(s) URL first. audit returns a report and writes no files. gen reads geoaeo.config.ts, .js, or .mjs and returns the artifact as text. It writes no file. humanize writes a file only when write is true and the text changes. submit posts URLs to IndexNow, which reaches Bing, Yandex, Naver, Seznam, and Yep. It sends a request to a third party; ask the user before you call it. Ask the user before you set write. When GEOAEO_ALLOWED_ROOTS is set, a local path must resolve inside one root. An http(s) audit URL stays allowed. A path outside the roots is an error.
